Hi Aaron,

I saw that The Nine Essential Questions for Organizational Transformation arrived this August, and the way it turns your field experience at Tengu Consulting into a clear set of questions for leaders really stood out to me.

I would love to invite you to be featured in an Author Spotlight on The Author Ledger. Alongside our editorial features, we also support authors with professionally produced audiobook editions, cinematic book trailers, short promotional reels, author websites, press kits, Amazon A+ graphics, and book relaunch materials.

Would you be interested in hearing more about the feature and the option I believe would suit The Nine Essential Questions for Organizational Transformation best?

Warm regards,
Oseni Ibrahim
